RF.limits: Nominal fabrication-art geometry only; exact feedpoint, dimensional/placement tolerances, housing, screws/cable/bridge metal and RF performance unresolved.

limits: Track-center graph excludes pad bodies and component/connector internal connections; it is not an electrical propagation model.
Nominal through barrel uses configured 1.6mm board thickness, not measured finished copper-layer distance or dielectric delay.
Plane samples are geometric screening only; antipads, return currents, lateral field extent and impedance require further analysis.
Ground-via distances and exposed pad geometry do not prove acceptable inductance or physical probe access.
No exact stackup, capacitance extraction, thermal model, RF model, prototype measurement or compliance test is supplied by this script.
